layoutConstraints: Mother metadata only. Use the existing ordinary-composite recipe to keep all32 competences in original order.
Six areas have9,5,5,3,4,6 items. Each competence has six original A1–C2 statements plus the separate0-point not-aware option.
2022 Toolkit complete item wording; official2023 report p.11/Annex1 per-item mapping. No silent repair of the2023 chapter4 omission at6.5.
The original whole-tool192-point bands are documented as provenance only and are not computed across the split tools.

intendedUses.notes: Index and ordinary-composite preparation, not a separate executable scale.
